row.body:
I saved the bottle for you because it smelled like the trial orchard after spraying. I poured out the glasses before the roadblock appeared.

We waited for a correction that never came. Every passing driver had a different instruction and no room for one more passenger.

I could have mistaken the order in which those things happened. I could not mistake the empty place left for the person we had been waiting for.

row.body:
I put aside four glasses after the men came in. They said the others would be back for them and asked me to write the names on a napkin.

I watched them pour the drinks away when they thought I had gone. The glasses were washed and returned to the shelf, but they kept the napkin.

One of the four had borrowed my coat. I still have the claim ticket for it, and no one will tell me where to take it.
row.title: The drinks still owed
